_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the independent code review (owner directive 2026-09-24: "codex is enabled en gebruikelijk is gefixt. gebruik gpt 6 astra op reasoning: extra high en long thinking op ja" -> model gpt-6-astra, effort xhigh; "long thinking" maps to xhigh, the CLI's highest reasoning effort — codex-cli 0.156.1 has no separate thinking flag (--help verified 2026-09-24). Earlier history: gpt-5.6-sol, pinned 2026-08-04, effort xhigh since 2026-08-09; on 2026-09-24 that model returned HTTP 400 on this ChatGPT account.) (owner directive 2026-08-04: 'dat moet codex op gpt 5.6 sol effort:max doen'; BIJGESTELD 2026-08-09 door de owner naar effort xhigh — 'kan je effort naar extra high doen in plaats van max?'. xhigh is live gevalideerd op gpt-5.6-sol met --strict-config, dus de waarde wordt echt geaccepteerd en niet stilzwijgend genegeerd.). Before this file existed the model was pinned NOWHERE: the codex-reviewer agent and the forge-code-review skill both said 'run /codex:review' and let the plugin pick whatever default it had, so a review could silently run on a weaker model than the owner asked for — measured 2026-08-03, when reaching gpt-5.6-sol at all first required upgrading the Codex CLI from 0.142.3 to 0.146.0. Every caller (agent prose, skill, plan step, report) must read the model/effort/command FROM HERE rather than restating them, so there is exactly one place to change.

review._min_cli_doc: gpt-6-astra at xhigh verified live 2026-09-24 on codex-cli 0.156.1 (ChatGPT login): codex exec -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh -s read-only --strict-config answered XHIGH-OK, exit 0 (20,517 tokens). Older note kept for history: gpt-5.6-sol needed >= 0.146.0 and was refused with HTTP 400 on this account on 2026-09-24.
review.command: codex exec -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh -s read-only "<review prompt>"
review.adversarial_command: codex exec -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh -s read-only "ADVERSARIAL CODE REVIEW. <focus>"
review.long_thinking: yes — expressed as model_reasoning_effort=xhigh (the highest level the CLI accepts; no separate flag exists in codex-cli 0.156.1)

naming._naming_doc: Plans used to name this work package 'ECC code-review', which described the FALLBACK as if it were the plan. The planned step is the Codex pass; ECC review is only what you fall back to, and it is labelled as such.

fallback.label: FALLBACK (non-independent) review — Codex did not run because: <reason>
fallback._fallback_doc: Never planned up front and never silently substituted: if Codex did not run, the report says so with the reason. An ECC pass is a second opinion from the same family of models that wrote the code, so it is not the independent review the owner asked for.

honesty._doc: If the configured model is unavailable (400 / CLI too old / not authed), report the ACTUAL model used or that the review was blocked. A review attributed to gpt-6-astra that ran on something else is a fabricated provenance.

operational_notes.effort_is_slow: A review at a high reasoning effort (max, and to a lesser degree xhigh) regularly runs LONGER THAN 10 MINUTES. Measured 2026-08-04: a 3-file review was still running at the 10-minute mark and had to be relaunched in the background. Always run it detached (background) and wait for completion — killing it mid-flight wastes the whole run.
operational_notes.exec_host_handshake_can_fail: Measured 2026-08-04: one effort=max run returned MODEL-USED plus "the read-only execution host repeatedly failed during handshake, even on a no-op" — i.e. Codex could not read any file and produced NO review. A follow-up run on the same flags at effort=low read the config fine and echoed back the pinned values, so this is intermittent, not a broken configuration. If a run reports a handshake failure, it produced no review: rerun it, and never present it as a completed review.
operational_notes.model_cannot_self_identify: Asked which model it is, Codex answers "GPT-5 (Codex; exact deployment ID is not exposed)". That is normal — a model cannot reliably self-report its deployment. The trustworthy evidence that the pin took effect is the CLI header line (model: gpt-6-astra) plus the fact that the flags were passed; do not treat the model's self-description as a contradiction.

Effort-wissel 2026-08-09: `codex exec -m gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh -s read-only --strict-config` draaide live en antwoordde XHIGH-OK — --strict-config bewijst dat de waarde herkend wordt en niet stil wordt genegeerd.
